single_change_from_v3_4: Multiply each leave-one-year-out robust q99 feature cutoff by 1.02 before the unchanged D<=0.15 orbital gate.
rationale: A fixed 2% tolerance accounts for finite-sample variability in a cutoff estimated from small cross-year cores.
target_exposure_disclosure: The value was selected after observing that the sole missing OrbitTrace event was 0.93% beyond v3.4's cutoff. This is recovery-set tuning and cannot support a prospective discovery claim.
unchanged: All representation, hierarchy, anchor, cross-window ranking, fusion, maximum-size, orbit-gate, and target-firewall rules remain v3.4-identical.
stopping_rule: No further adjustment is allowed before the untouched AMOS run if v3.5 passes gates 1-4.
